data.name: CLUBX
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to CLUBX, the next-generation social metaverse platform where you can connect with global users in real-time, transcending time and space!

CLUBX breaks down the barriers of borders and languages, allowing you to meet new friends and enjoy diverse content anytime, anywhere. Create your own unique avatar, explore beautifully designed 3D spaces, and dive into a vibrant metaverse life full of non-stop excitement.

[Key Features & Characteristics] 

1. Seamless Communication via Real-Time Voice & Text Chat

* Vibrant Voice Chat: Share your emotions through high-quality, real-time voice chat that makes you feel like you're standing right next to each other.

* Expressive Text & Emojis: Chat effortlessly with global users using our flexible chat system that supports multiple languages and fun emojis.

2. Limitless Virtual Spaces & Global Networking

* Diverse Themed Spaces: Immersive 3D environments await you—including dazzling festival stages, trendy clubs, and cozy lounges.

* Borderless Networking: Meet, chat, and instantly bond with diverse people logging in from all over the world for a truly unique social dynamic.

3. Non-Stop Metaverse Content & Action-Packed Battles

* Live Music & Parties: Feel the vibe and party hard with your avatar to real-time DJ sets and live audio streaming.

* Dynamic Combat Battles: Gear up by purchasing weapons in the virtual world and engage in thrilling battles with other users.

* Community Events: Participate in live events and hidden activities scattered throughout the spaces to earn special rewards.

4. Your Own Digital Persona (Avatar Customization)

* Detailed Customization: Mix and match various hairstyles, outfits, and accessories to create a one-of-a-kind character that represents you.

* Expressive Motions: Use diverse body language—such as dancing, greeting, and cheering—to express yourself even more richly in the virtual world. 

Download CLUBX right now and become the main character of the metaverse social life you’ve always imagined!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700 / Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes such as nightlife settings, social interactions, and suggestive content. There is no explicit sexual activity or extreme violence.
